compositionNote: Original procedural music. The C-major section uses Bach-inspired four-voice imitation; no Bach composition is used.

gains.overloadHarmonics: 0.025 / sqrt(layerIndex + 1), added from each timeline chunk frame with subtle per-layer pan; held until the hard gate at sample 960000.

overloadNoise.shaping: 0.32 first-difference bright emphasis followed by tanh saturation

gains.counterpointDevelopment: A planned 48-note line per voice: the original 12-note subject, its diatonic dominant answer, an octave development, and a closing C-major variation; entries are staggered by 120 frames and each line is gated at frame 8400.
gains.pcmPolicy: No mix normalization or blanket clipping; generation stops if any output reaches 0.8 sample peak.
